targets.name: Roof-panel bee
targets.concealment: The small bee is a flat gold fitting amid the same gold leaf outlines and brown grain of the beam panel.

targets.name: Fox in the book niche
targets.concealment: The fox is recessed among brown books and autumn leaves and matches the warm wood.

targets.name: Luna moth on the window
targets.concealment: Green wings echo the nearby leaf shapes in the patterned hexagonal window.

targets.name: Hare in the wood niche
targets.concealment: The hare shares the timber color and narrow book-like outline within the shelf recess.

targets.name: Round lotus seedpod
targets.concealment: The brown perforated pod repeats the small holes and curves of the surrounding shelf ornament.

targets.name: Bookcase hedgehog
targets.concealment: The golden-brown spines merge into gold-leaf decoration on adjacent blue books.

targets.name: Round amber bottle
targets.concealment: The small amber bottle blends into warm brass highlights and brown glass behind the work counter.

targets.name: Wide glass jar
targets.concealment: Transparent jar edges and dried stems merge with layered shelf reflections and fine book decoration.

targets.name: Painted cup bee
targets.concealment: The small bee is a flat drawing integrated into a honeycomb-patterned ceramic cup.

targets.name: Dragonfly on the throw
targets.concealment: Gold wings and a blue body mingle with gold leaves and blue cloth folds.

targets.name: Folding brass dividers
targets.concealment: The small foreground drafting tool shares the desk’s gold-brown color and overlaps a second brass instrument; the separate ring-handled tool behind is a distractor.

targets.name: Large observatory telescope
targets.concealment: The large telescope and mount are the room’s clear visual anchor.

targets.name: Desk magnifying glass
targets.concealment: The large magnifier lies openly on the foreground desk.

targets.name: Ornate pocket watch
targets.concealment: The large ornate watch is clearly displayed beside the open book.

targets.name: Large clover-handled key
targets.concealment: The oversized key is isolated at the near edge of the desk.

review.notes: All 15 targets inspected against enlarged source ROIs and final context-outline sheet. Repaired full moth tails, bee appendages, animal ears/feet/spines, dragonfly wings and legs, bottle/jar occlusion boundaries, telescope and magnifier silhouettes, watch ring, key loops, and foreground folding dividers. Separate overlapping ring-handled tool is excluded. All polygons and actual handle/support holes are valid. Physical iPhone review remains pending.
